population.native_final: Separate official-clean intent contract; no new semantic admission inferred.

quality_cohort.selection: Deterministic uniform ordering of eligible source groups; exclude inventoried author reference groups, no class/prediction/reference-text routing.
quality_cohort.limitation: Not proof of never-seen sources; inventoried exposure exclusions only. Sparse positive types may remain underpowered. Never use this cohort as the main training population.

review_protocol.proposer: Pinned teacher and fixed complete question panels, no native labels or author judgments.
review_protocol.blind_reviewer: Separate reviewer creates judgments from the same reference and rules without proposer answers, rationales, native labels or author references. Freeze reviewer identity/version before output collection.
review_protocol.independence: Same author rereview or same-model repeat is not independent semantic certification. A different model is a second model opinion, not human gold; correlated errors remain possible.
review_protocol.adjudication: Adjudicate every disagreement and all unavailable/conflict cases with evidence and both original judgments retained. Audit agreements as well; no majority vote or automatic positive/negative admission.
review_protocol.reference_vs_audio: Reference-text judgments remain reference-based supervision. Audibility/transcript mismatch flags require recording-specific listening; no inherited all-recordings-listened claim.
review_protocol.missing: Failed, truncated, malformed or omitted answers remain explicit failures with original denominators; no implicit negatives, partial JSON salvage, or automatic retry.
review_protocol.agreement_output: Three-state confusion and completeness by family, panel and definition; disagreement is separate from API failure.

preregistered_quality_gates.transport_scope: All scheduled requests in each pass; failures remain denominator. Aggregate gate never hides a systematically failing panel.
preregistered_quality_gates.semantic_bound: For each family and each admitted proposed polarity, one-sided95 percent lower bound on correctness against adjudicated review must be at least0.95. Resample all128 source groups with replacement,10000 replicates,numpy default_rng seed317. Within each replicate sum correctly proposed coordinates divided by all proposed coordinates of that family/polarity;5th percentile with method=lower. A zero denominator is nonestimable and blocks that gate. Report raw numerator/denominator and group counts. Do not treat120 correlated predicates as120 independent sources.
preregistered_quality_gates.audit_reference: The separate blind reviewer covers every cohort coordinate; the adjudicator checks every disagreement and unavailable plus every positive/negative agreement used in the quality numerator. Persist final adjudicator status and evidence. No unchecked agreement is automatically correct. Reference-text audit is not audio gold.
preregistered_quality_gates.interval_limit: Cluster bootstrap is a descriptive finite-cohort bound, can degenerate with zero observed errors, and cannot certify unseen classes or systematic shared errors. Report these limits, class support and blinded reviewer method alongside it; the numeric gate alone is insufficient.
preregistered_quality_gates.per_definition: Report proposed/adjudicated positive,negative,unavailable,missing and disagreement counts. Every trained predicate must have independently reviewed positive and negative support; a one-example anchor does not certify a type.
preregistered_quality_gates.underpowered_or_failed: No pass claim. Freeze a separate coverage supplement and its sampling bias before review; never fold targeted positive sampling into representative prevalence/accuracy. Affected labels remain masked until their contract passes.
preregistered_quality_gates.definition_conflict: Unresolved contradiction in rules blocks that definition; genuine input ambiguity remains unavailable and does not require changing the rules.
preregistered_quality_gates.scope: Quality control for reference-based annotation, not proof of audio accuracy or task-generalization gains. Class coverage and actor-menu supervision adequacy must also be checked at full-population release.

bulk_annotation.prerequisites: Calibration terminal reviewed; quality reviewer identity and method fixed; quality gates evaluated; full cost and resource budget frozen; resumable executor accepted. None automatically satisfied by this file.
bulk_annotation.proposals: Complete fixed panels across all9192 sources. Preserve every coordinate and failure state.
bulk_annotation.independent_checks: Blind quality cohort plus all low-confidence/disagreement/ambiguous cases; polarity and definition coverage supplement selected after proposals, before independent review, with separate denominators.
bulk_annotation.release: Explicit versioned admission decision and annotation_method for every usable coordinate; teacher outputs remain proposals until release policy and review evidence are satisfied.
bulk_annotation.recording_binding: All explicit source IDs must have compatible admitted values; never propagate via source_group or omitted native annotations.
bulk_annotation.selection_test: Learning only. Selection annotations use frozen rules and separate manifests, never optimization; target test feedback cannot tune templates/checkpoints.

cost.prompt_cost: Must use observed per-panel usage and frozen request counts; representative cost projection is not a guaranteed token bound. No assumed price or total fee.
cost.second_pass_and_adjudication: Additional explicit budgets required; not included in one-pass caps.
cost.execution: No API dispatch by this protocol or cohort builder.
